title: 8AN Braided Black Nylon Hose / Line (E85 + Race Fuel Safe) - BY THE FOOT
description:
The 8AN Braided Black Nylon Hose / Line (E85 + Race Fuel Safe) - BY THE FOOT is a high-performance component engineered for demanding automotive applications. ColorFittings Standard Black Nylon Braided Hose is engineered for high-pressure fuel, oil, coolant, and breather applications in automotive, marine, and racing builds. Featuring a durable synthetic rubber inner core with a tightly woven black nylon braid, this hose resists abrasion and pressure delivering reliable flow, excellent flexibility, and consistent performance under demanding conditions.

Designed for racing, street performance, and marine applications, this hose is compatible with E85, ethanol-based fuels, race fuels, gasoline, diesel, oil, and coolant. The black nylon braid provides superior abrasion resistance and a clean, blacked-out look while maintaining the flexibility needed for tight, precise routing.

This hose is designed to be used as part of the ColorFittings system. For a proper seal and reliable performance, pair it with their Standard AN Hose Fittings, precision-machined to match this hose. Use Hose Separators to organize multi-line installations and prevent abrasion, and complete assembly with their Hose Assembly Tools to ensure correct alignment, prevent damage, and achieve professional results.

Technical Specifications:
• Construction: Precision machined for rigorous track and street applications.
